patch_description: Prepend a global RX rotation layer with a shared parameter before the existing RY layer. This adds orthogonal single-qubit expressivity (RX vs RY/RZ) with minimal parameter cost (adds 1 distinct parameter: 7→8). The shared `rx_shared` parameter provides a unified phase control across all qubits, which can improve separation of difficult samples and enhance the circuit's ability to encode task-relevant features. This multi-phase early-stage processing is known to improve worst-group margins in small datasets where robust generalization matters.
